description: This file contains functions related to database operations for MCP (Multi-Cloud Provider) servers, including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion. It also includes utility functions for handling credentials encryption, JSON serialization, and access control based on team or verification token. The code integrates with a Prisma client to interact with the database and manages data models related to MCP servers, object permissions, and virtual keys.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _prepare_mcp_server_data( data: Union[NewMCPServerRequest, UpdateMCPServerRequest], )
methods.description: Prepares MCP server data for database insert/update, serializing JSON fields and encrypting credentials.

methods.name: MCPCredentials encrypt_credentials( credentials: MCPCredentials, encryption_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Encrypts sensitive fields within the MCP credentials using a provided encryption key.

methods.description: Fetches a specific MCP server by server ID.

methods.description: Creates a new MCP server record, initializing with provided data and handling JSON serialization and encryption.
